If the key is retired in favor of the existing L["Multi Meters"] (enUS.lua:62), every reader and test must move together; if test_locale checks for unused or duplicate keys, a leftover key fails it.

Many tests pin the brand string. These include tests/run.lua:461 (kit diagnostics brand), test_diagnostics:43, test_launchersetup (94,118,294,480,494,894,951), test_skinsetup:81, test_disabled:165, test_slash_refusal:179, test_locale:59 and wow_mock:1111. All must change with the code or the suite goes red.

Collision: the brand becomes 'Multi Meters', which is the same string the window header default already uses (Schema.lua:159 window.name default, Window_Header.lua:448, Database.lua:232 'Multi Meters #%d'), the export head (Export.lua:472) and the MasterControls addonName (Schema_Compose.lua:547). No functional clash, but code comments and tests that tell the brand apart from the window name by string (for example LauncherSetup.lua:318-325 'two fields, two jobs') lose that distinction, and a test that asserts brand ~= window name would break.

Settings category: parentTitle 'Ka0s Multi Meters' (OptionsSetup.lua:147) is the Blizzard Settings category name. If anything opens the panel by that name, not by the returned category ID, it has to change too. The landing page in the AddOns list also sorts differently: 'Multi Meters' moves from K to M.

The Keybindings section title changes (BINDING_HEADER_MULTIMETERS value). The binding name 'CLICK MultiMetersToggleWindows:LeftButton' must NOT change, or every player's key unbinds (Bindings.xml:8 warns about this).

The skin owner label (SkinSetup.lua:742) feeds LibKa0s 'Copy to every Ka0s addon' confirmations and the first-run picker queue, and the skin picker title appears in the image-based smoke rows (SKIN-*). Expect owner re-smoke.

EllesmereUI's third-party list probably shows the TOC Title, so the owner's smoke instructions at smoke-tests.md:1975/1978 change wording. SavedVariables are keyed by folder, so the rename loses no data.

The CurseForge project name is not in the repo (.pkgmeta has only package-as: MultiMeters, and the TOC has X-Curse-Project-ID 1690082). Renaming the CurseForge project page is a manual owner step outside the repo.

It is a feature verb, so it is refused while the addon is disabled). NS.Sim is built from LibKa0s-Sim-1.0 by Lib:New{ name="MultiMeters", seam=NS.SimSeam, slash="/mm sim", ... } at modules/Sim.lua:327. If the library is missing, core/SimSetup.lua:150 installs a stub (newSimStub at :112-133: Start/RunVerb print 'The simulator needs LibKa0s-Sim-1.0.', Status answers {active=false}). The functions are NS.Sim:Start(...), NS.Sim:Stop(reason) (called with 'profile' at core/Database.lua:80 and with 'standDown' at core/LifecycleSetup.lua:138), NS.Sim:IsActive() for the query, NS.Sim:Status()/Session()/Steps()/Step(), and NS.Sim:RunVerb(arg). The launcher hooks are in core/LauncherSetup.lua:352-358: isSimMode = NS.Sim:IsActive(), and toggleSim = s:RunVerb(s:IsActive() and 'stop' or ''). On a running sim, toggleSim stops it. Otherwise the bare verb prints status and opens the sim step panel ('Multi Meters - Simulation', modules/Sim.lua:311). The fight itself starts from the panel or from /mm sim <scenario>. Starting plays a scripted fight through the real meter (SimWorld/SimDrivers/SimScenario), saves nothing (pins are snapshotted and restored, modules/Sim.lua:216-246), and prints STARTED (Sim.lua:291). It stops on combat, world, group, instance, profile change or stand-down (Sim.lua:280-285). Test mode and the sim refuse each other. The Behavior tab already has a sim setting, sim.stepDelay (settings/Schema_General.lua:257-266), but there is no on/off checkbox for the sim.

per.simApi: Slash: /lh sim <verb> (settings/Schema.lua:1240, which calls NS.Sim:RunVerb(rest or "")). The verbs are the library's start <scenario>, run, step, pause, resume, restart, stop, status and panel, plus the host verb loot [n]. A bare /lh sim shows status and the sim panel. The session is built at modules/Sim.lua:358-380 with NS.Sim = LibStub('LibKa0s-Sim-1.0'):New{ name='LootHistory', slash='/lh sim', scenarios=Host.SCENARIOS, ... }. Without LibKa0s it is the stub Host.NewSimStub (modules/Sim.lua:382, core/SimSeam.lua:99-111), which answers 'The simulator needs LibKa0s-Sim-1.0.'. Query: NS.Sim:IsActive() and NS.Sim:IsPanelShown(). Stop: NS.Sim:Stop(reason) or NS.SimStop(reason) (modules/Sim.lua:435). NS.SimBlocks(what) (modules/Sim.lua:441) refuses destructive verbs while a sim runs. Launcher hooks: isSimMode / toggleSim at core/LauncherSetup.lua:200-206; toggleSim calls s:RunVerb(s:IsActive() and 'stop' or ''), so it stops a running sim or otherwise shows status and the panel, never starting one. There are six scenarios in modules/SimScenario.lua:387-395: loot, key, vendor, ah, bank, social. Starting one (Host.Prepare, modules/Sim.lua:261-277) seeds a session world and swaps in session stores, so nothing is saved. It resets the Reconciler and Attribution, installs the real-event filter and world watch, runs a silent genesis scan, opens the History window (openWindow, modules/Sim.lua:250) and docks the sim panel beside it, titled '<BRAND> - Simulation' (modules/SimPanel.lua:97). The sim stops itself on combat, a group, an instance, real world activity, a stand-down or a profile change.

**LibKa0s: where it draws addon names, and what a Sim checkbox in MasterControls would need**

Library at `/mnt/d/Profile/Users/Tushar/Documents/GIT/LibKa0s/LibKa0s`. I only read files and changed nothing.

## (1) Addon names the library draws

**Main finding:** the library never reads the TOC `Title` and never adds "Ka0s" to a host's name. Every addon-name string it draws comes from the host's descriptor. The only TOC reader is the generic `Env.lua:61` `lib.GetAddOnMetadata`, which nothing calls with `"Title"`. `Slash.lua:366` even forbids deriving the brand from the TOC Title, because a Title can carry color escapes. So renaming the hosts is mostly a host-side change: whatever string each host passes is what appears.

Host-supplied name sites:

| Site | Field | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Settings category name, main page header and every breadcrumb | `d.parentTitle` | `OptionsRegistry.lua:156` and `:172` (`Settings.RegisterCanvasLayoutCategory(mainCtx.panel, d.parentTitle)`); `Options.lua:336` (doc), `:577` (`displayTitle = parentTitle .. BREADCRUMB_SEP .. title`), `:643` (`panel.title`). There is no shared "Ka0s" parent category: each host registers its own top-level category under its `parentTitle`. |
| Launcher (LDB label, tooltip title, right-click menu title) | `d.label` | `Launcher.lua:192-193` (doc), `:348-351` (`d.label or name`, then `TOOLTIP_TITLE_VERSION`), `:461` (`root:CreateTitle(d.label or name)`), `:537` (LDB `label`). `name` is the folder, which has no "Ka0s" in it. |
| Addon Compartment | none | The library registers no compartment entry. The compartment shows the TOC `## Title`, so only the TOC change matters there. |
| "<X> is disabled" chat line | `d.brandName` | `Slash.lua:550`. |
| Diagnostics begin/end markers | `d.brandName`, falling back to `d.title` | `DebugLogDiagnostics.lua:335-337`, `:365`, `:375`. |
| Debug console title | `d.title` | `DebugLogWindow.lua:455` (`d.title .. " — Debug"`, suffix at `DebugLog.lua:119`). |
| Perf panel title | `d.title or d.name` | `Perf.lua:609`, `PerfPanel.lua:262`. |
| Sim panel title | `d.title`, a string or a function | `SimPanelRender.lua:119-123`, `:172`, `:365`. |
| Copy window title | `d.title` | `WidgetsCopyWindow.lua:99`, `:211`. |
| Skin owner label (used in the Appearance copy dialog list) | `opts.label` | `Skin.lua:326`, `:387` (`OwnerLabel`), used at `OptionsAppearance.lua:735`. |
| "Enable <AddonName>" row | `spec.addonName` | `OptionsCompose.lua:466`. |
| Chat prefix | `d.prefix`, verbatim | `Core.lua:868-904`. Nothing is synthesized. |
| Skin picker title | none | Fixed `"Choose a skin"` (`OptionsSkinPicker.lua:185`, `:1309`). `TITLE_FOR` was already retired (`:115`), so the picker title names no addon. |

**What would change in the library itself (all text, no logic):**
- **Docs and an error message that prescribe the `Ka0s <Name>` spelling:**
  - `Slash.lua:362` (comment), `:367-368` (the error string "the plain-text `Ka0s <Name>`"), `:434` (descriptor doc).
  - `DebugLog.lua:244` (brandName doc).

  These are the only places the library writes the brand convention down. They should say `<Name>`, or "the addon's plain-text name". The matching rule in the standard (launcher-§1, "the same string the LDB object takes as its label") would change with them.
- **Strings that name the collection, not an addon.** Whether these keep "Ka0s" is the owner's call:
  - `OptionsSkinPicker.lua:190` "Apply to all Ka0s addons", `:191` (APPLY_ALL_TIP), `:209` (VERB_QUEUED "Another Ka0s addon's skin picker…").
  - `OptionsAppearance.lua:114-118` "Ka0s skins" (SOURCE_KA0S and its tip), `:124` "Copy to every Ka0s addon…", `:151` "Other Ka0s addons", `:152` (COPY_TIP), `:154` (COPY_NONE).
- **Leave alone:**
  - Media names "Ka0s Prototype", "Ka0s Default" and so on (`Media.lua:220-329`, `SkinDefs.lua:324/435/530`, `SkinDefsOthers.lua`, `OptionsCompose.lua:369`). These are LSM keys stored in saved variables.
  - `Bus.lua:378` `"Ka0s_" .. addonName .. "_"`, an internal message-name prefix that is never shown.

**Host-side work this implies:** each addon changes the strings it passes (`parentTitle`, launcher `label`, `brandName`, DebugLog/Perf/Sim `title`, skin owner `label`, `addonName`, `prefix` if it contains Ka0s) plus its TOC `## Title`. Keep `Launcher` `name` as the folder: LibDBIcon keys the saved minimap position by it (`Launcher.lua:185-188`).

## (2) MasterControls: the Test checkbox, and what a Sim checkbox needs

**How Test is built today.** `O.MasterControls(spec)` is at `OptionsCompose.lua:933-973`, with its rows in `masterRows` (`:462-533`).
- **The Test row** is emitted only when `spec.testModePath` is set (`:520-531`): `type="bool"`, label "Test mode", `sessionOnly=true`. It takes the path verbatim, like the console row. The host binds get/set for that path through its descriptor's `d.get`/`d.set`.
- **Placement.** Test pairs beside "Minimap button" (`startsLine = (not minimapRow or not minimapRow.startsLine) or nil`). Under the frameless packing, Minimap sits beside Debug console (`:509-512`) and Test opens its own line.
- **`lockIsPreview`** (`:481`) only swaps the Lock frame tooltip to `LOCK_PREVIEW_TIP` (`:433`). It is an error together with `testModePath` (`:935-937`).
- **Docs and notes.** The descriptor docs are at `:888-912`. The `notes` leaves are listed at `:902-905`, and `emitNoted` is at `:445`.
- **Version bookkeeping.** `COMPOSE_MINOR = 18` (`:29`). The golden layout fixture is `tests/fixture_compose_golden.lua` (`MasterControls/framed` at `:80`).

**What a Sim checkbox would need:**

1. **A spec hook.** There are two ways:
   - **(a) `simPath`, a mirror of `testModePath`.** The host maps a session path to the sim in its `d.get`/`d.set`. This is simple, but every host must add that path mapping.
   - **(b) Recommended: `isSim`/`toggleSim` functions, the launcher's own names.** The flow engine already supports path-less rows with their own `row.get`/`row.set` (`OptionsWidgets.lua:345-375`, Options minor 15). One problem: `emit` always assigns `row.path` unless `spec.bind` is set (`OptionsCompose.lua:271-272`). So `emit` would have to skip the path for a row that carries `get`/`set`, or the Sim row would be built outside `emit`.

   Either way, every addon with a sim already has the launcher pair (`Launcher.lua:216-219`, `:153`). The hosts are AbsorbTracker, BankLedger, DpsRace, DropWatcher, KickCD, LootHistory and MultiMeters (`core/LauncherSetup.lua`). A shared `NS.IsSimMode`/`NS.ToggleSim` could feed both the launcher and MasterControls.
2. **Value-based set, not a toggle.** The global reset walks `sessionOnly` rows and calls `d.applyDefault(row)` (`Options.lua:895-898`, `:979-986`). It does this even when `resetProfile` narrows the walk. So a Sim row's set must be `set(v)`: start when `v` is true and the sim is idle, `Sim:Stop("reset")` when `v` is false (`Sim.lua:567`, re-entrancy safe and answering false when idle). A raw `toggleSim` would start a sim on reset. The row's get is `Sim:IsActive()` (`Sim.lua:584`). Start is `Sim:Start(opts)` (`:548`), or the host's bare verb `Sim:RunVerb("")` (`SimTimeline.lua:621`). DpsRace's `toggleSim` (`DpsRace/core/LauncherSetup.lua:107-113`) shows that hosts differ here: stop if running, otherwise the bare verb opens the idle step panel. The composer should call the host's function and not pick a scenario itself.
3. **Live refresh.** The sim starts and stops outside the panel: slash, the sim panel, auto-stop, prepare failure. The checkbox goes stale unless something refreshes it. `Sim:AddListener(fn)` (`Sim.lua:651`, fired by `notify` at `:415`, `:563` and `:577`) is the hook.
